description: Toggle an automation rule between active and inactive. This flips the current state, so call get_automation first if you need to know which way it will flip. An active automation runs on its own every time its trigger fires, and its steps can send email, post to Slack, call webhook URLs, and run actions in connected third-party apps. For a Composio app-event trigger, this also creates or removes the event subscription on the connected third-party account.
